name: Classroom 5H (evaluation layout, owner 21 Oct 2026: the window wall is to the left of the timetable wall) — moving things marked per the motion sheet (playbook 4ab), 21 Oct 2026
palette: the walls are cream above a pale mint band; the band's top edge is at a child's shoulder height, 42% of the way up the back wall from the floor; the floor is pale wood; accents teal and purple
box: a shallow box in one-point perspective: a wide back wall running the full width, narrow side walls, a thin strip of ceiling, a low floor band
light: the only daylight comes from the big window on the window wall; afternoon sun

c4.name: the timetable wall (north)
c4.light: daylight comes from the LEFT, from the window wall; every object casts a soft shadow to its right, and a band of sun lies across the floor from the left

objects.label: RULES poster
objects.text: a small poster headed RULES with no words on it, only a few blank lines

objects.label: 5H TIMETABLE poster
objects.text: a large timetable poster with a teal header bar reading 5H TIMETABLE, a row of six small coloured subject icons under it (pencil, atlas, flask, paintbrush, football, music note), and below them an empty grid of pale lines, five rows by six columns, with nothing written in it

objects.label: clock, blank face
objects.text: a round white wall clock with a plain empty white face: no hands, no numbers

objects.label: low bookshelf
objects.text: a low wooden bookshelf, two shelves, a few colourful books standing on the shelves inside it with plain blank spines, nothing on top

objects.label: desk + chair
objects.text: a plain white envelope with nothing written on it, lying flat
objects.absent: a child's school desk with a pale wooden top and grey legs, standing a step out from the wall with floor showing behind its legs; a teal plastic chair pushed in under it with its back to the viewer; on the desk a purple pencil case and nothing else: the rest of the desk top is bare

objects.label: backpack
objects.text: a purple school backpack on the floor beside the desk
objects.absent: bare floor beside the desk, where a backpack will stand: nothing there

objects.label: filing cabinet + cage
objects.text: a small golden hamster the size of a fist, sitting up, seen from the front
objects.absent: a blue two-drawer filing cabinet with a wire hamster cage on top, the cage a closed box with a solid lid, a wheel and a water bottle hanging inside, and no hamster in it: the cage is empty

c1.name: the whiteboard wall (east), to the right of the timetable wall
c1.light: daylight comes from behind the viewer, from the window wall; shadows fall behind the objects, away from the viewer

objects.label: tall teal cupboard
objects.text: a tall teal double-door supplies cupboard with a small white label reading SUPPLIES on one door

objects.label: whiteboard, blank
objects.text: a wide whiteboard, completely blank, with a marker tray along its bottom edge holding one red and one blue marker

objects.label: teacher's desk
objects.text: the teacher's desk, pale wood with two drawers, standing a step out from the wall; on it a red mug, a small stack of three books with blank spines, and an apple

c3.name: the door wall (south), opposite the timetable wall
c3.light: daylight comes from the RIGHT, from the window wall; every object casts a soft shadow to its left

objects.label: green bin
objects.text: a green recycling bin on the floor

objects.label: teal door, closed
objects.text: a teal classroom door, closed, with a square window in its upper half, a small white sign reading 5H at eye height and a round brass handle

objects.label: coat pegs + raincoat
objects.text: a wooden rail of coat pegs with one pale blue raincoat hanging from it

objects.label: LOST PROPERTY box
objects.text: a cardboard box on the floor labelled LOST PROPERTY with a red shoe and a blue hat poking out of the top

c2.name: the window wall (west), to the left of the timetable wall
c2.light: light comes through the window from outside; the sill and the floor below it are bright, and the radiator and pots cast soft shadows towards the viewer

objects.label: window: sky, sun, cloud, aeroplane, treetops
objects.text: a wide window with white frames and clear glass, showing a bright blue afternoon sky with a sun, one small cloud, a tiny distant aeroplane, and round green tropical treetops along the bottom of the view; treetops only, no buildings, no skyline

objects.label: 4 pots, 4 heights, blank labels
objects.text: on the white window sill, four terracotta pots in a row with bean plants at four different heights, from left to right a bare shoot, a small plant, a middling plant and a tall leafy one, each pot with a small plain white label with nothing written on it

objects.label: cream radiator
objects.text: a cream radiator with vertical ribs standing against the wall under the window
